description: The state government signed 21 agreements at the prestigious two-day Global Artificial Intelligence Summit (GAIS) that started in Hyderabad on Thursday. Agreements were made with various educational institutions, major technology firms, and seed companies, aligning with Telangana's development goals under the 'AI-based Telangana' initiative.
body_lead: Telangana Government Signs 21 Key Agreements at Global AI Summit The state government signed 21 agreements at the prestigious two-day Global Artificial Intelligence Summit (GAIS) that started in Hyderabad on Thursday. Agreements were made with various educational institutions, major technology firms, and seed companies, aligning with Telangana's development goals under the 'AI-based Telangana' initiative.
